status: candidate-only browser evidence; does not pass Gate 1

inputStress.definition: one directional intent is one synthetic keydown/keyup tap; reversal means the next intent is opposite the previous intent; cross-turn means it is perpendicular; each batch is dispatched synchronously within one in-flight 150ms step and latest-tap-wins selects the next tile direction

latency.definition: last synthetic keydown in each in-step batch to the first requestAnimationFrame sample observing the next committed tile; browser-side observation only

limitations: 合成鍵盤事件在單一瀏覽器頁面同步派送；未包含作業系統、硬體鍵盤或真實使用者輸入延遲。
延遲為輸入事件到 RAF 首次觀測 committed tile 的瀏覽器端量測，不代表畫面完成轉向或主觀回應時間。
Chromium 取樣不驗收實機、觸控、60／120 FPS、原生 DPR 光柵、動作美術品質或 Gate 1。
動畫幀記錄是 RAF 取樣，短幀可能被取樣跳過；latest-tap queue 對每個步進只保留最後方向。
